description: Compare up to four extensions side by side: users, stars, rating counts, versions, permissions and recent permission changes. For historical comparisons, call extension_trends for each ID; this is not code-similarity detection.

eids.description: One to four extension IDs to compare, in the desired display order. Use distinct IDs.

items.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

name: extension_compare
